# VHEATM

> Machine-validated, AI-native audit control plane. An evaluator decides
> whether each of 22 hard gates is active/inactive/unknown from a declared
> audit context; a router deterministically selects the validated
> instruction modules a plan requires; a report validator checks the final
> audit report before it may be treated as complete. Prose never overrides
> the schemas, manifest, or code — see the source-of-truth order below.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what VHEATM is, install paths (pip/uvx, MCP,
  Claude Code plugin, container), quick start commands.
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): compact execution router for an AI agent driving an
  audit.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): non-negotiable invariants for anyone (human or AI)
  contributing to this repository.

## Source of truth, in order

1. `manifests/vheatm-v17.yaml` — phases, gates, activation expressions.
2. `policies/runtime-boundaries.yaml` — runtime trust/safety policy.
3. `schemas/` — machine contracts for context, plans, modules, reports.
4. `modules/registry.yaml` and `modules/*/module.yaml` — digest-bound
   instruction modules.
5. `SKILL.md` — router; cannot override the artifacts above.
6. `src/vheatm_control/` — executable validation, planning, routing,
   enforcement, provenance.
7. `tests/`
8. `docs/` — explanation only, never authoritative.

## Interfaces

- CLI: `vheatm-validate`, `vheatm-evaluate`, `vheatm-route`,
  `vheatm-validate-report`, `vheatm-init`, `vheatm-doctor`.
- MCP server (`vheatm-mcp`, optional `[mcp]` extra): tools
  `vheatm_validate`, `vheatm_evaluate`, `vheatm_route`,
  `vheatm_validate_report`.
- Claude Code plugin: `plugins/vheatm/` (bundles the MCP server + a
  self-bootstrap hook).
